value.rationale: The natural unit-group functor on all minimal noncommutative centrally essential rings collapses exactly 88 ring classes to five distinct groups, with a complete characteristic-sensitive fiber census. The classification exposes precisely what this basic functor forgets and supplies useful intrinsic signatures; it is not a routine arbitrary numerical slice.
